trigger_condition.memory_trigger: Output tensor shares storage with the input tensor
trigger_condition.state_trigger: out= argument is used and aliases the input tensor
trigger_condition.execution_trigger: torch.addmm called with out=input where input is the bias tensor
trigger_condition.concrete_constraints: The out tensor and input tensor alias or share storage; shapes allow addmm; operation completes but produces values different from the non-aliased reference.

bug_oracle.description: torch.addmm with out= aliasing the input returns a tensor whose values differ from the non-aliased torch.addmm result.

harness_strategy.input_mutation: Generate aliasing relationships where the out tensor is the same object or shares storage with the addmm bias input tensor.
harness_strategy.tensor_construction: Construct CUDA tensors with compatible shapes for torch.addmm and reuse the input tensor as the out argument.
harness_strategy.constraint_injection: Force the out= argument to alias the input tensor while keeping mat1 and mat2 independent.
harness_strategy.operation_sequence: Run torch.addmm(input, mat1, mat2, out=input) and compare it with torch.addmm(input, mat1, mat2).
harness_strategy.oracle_construction: Use the non-aliased torch.addmm result as the reference result; flag any mismatch as incorrect output.
